assets.description_en: Make the first decisive action clear.
assets.description_zh: 明确迈出的第一个动作。

description.en: Make the first decisive action clear.
description.zh: 明确迈出的第一个动作。

assets.description_en: Keep one promising idea compact enough to begin.
assets.description_zh: 把一个有希望的想法收拢到可以开始。

description.en: Keep one promising idea compact enough to begin.
description.zh: 把一个有希望的想法收拢到可以开始。

assets.description_en: Release the hold that prevents a start.
assets.description_zh: 释放阻止开始的约束。

description.en: Release the hold that prevents a start.
description.zh: 释放阻止开始的约束。

assets.description_en: Give the next action a tangible trigger.
assets.description_zh: 为下一步提供明确的触发点。

description.en: Give the next action a tangible trigger.
description.zh: 为下一步提供明确的触发点。

assets.description_en: Turn a faint possibility into an active idea.
assets.description_zh: 让微弱的可能成为行动中的想法。

description.en: Turn a faint possibility into an active idea.
description.zh: 让微弱的可能成为行动中的想法。

assets.description_en: Release the energy gathered before a start.
assets.description_zh: 释放开始之前积蓄的能量。

description.en: Release the energy gathered before a start.
description.zh: 释放开始之前积蓄的能量。

assets.description_en: Join separate parts around a shared purpose.
assets.description_zh: 围绕共同目标连接独立部分。

description.en: Join separate parts around a shared purpose.
description.zh: 围绕共同目标连接独立部分。

assets.description_en: Give a flat proposal a more useful shape.
assets.description_zh: 让平面的提议形成更有用的结构。

description.en: Give a flat proposal a more useful shape.
description.zh: 让平面的提议形成更有用的结构。

assets.description_en: Hold the structure while keeping it adjustable.
assets.description_zh: 稳住结构，同时保留调整空间。

description.en: Hold the structure while keeping it adjustable.
description.zh: 稳住结构，同时保留调整空间。

assets.description_en: Change direction without breaking continuity.
assets.description_zh: 改变方向而不打断连续性。

description.en: Change direction without breaking continuity.
description.zh: 改变方向而不打断连续性。

assets.description_en: Connect different surfaces so they can still move.
assets.description_zh: 让不同部分联结后仍能变化。

description.en: Connect different surfaces so they can still move.
description.zh: 让不同部分联结后仍能变化。

assets.description_en: Find a useful curve within a rigid route.
assets.description_zh: 在直接路径中找到有用的弯曲。

description.en: Find a useful curve within a rigid route.
description.zh: 在直接路径中找到有用的弯曲。

assets.description_en: Return what is learned to the next trial.
assets.description_zh: 把获得的认识带回下一轮尝试。

description.en: Return what is learned to the next trial.
description.zh: 把获得的认识带回下一轮尝试。

assets.description_en: Make changing test conditions visible.
assets.description_zh: 让变化的试验条件可见。

description.en: Make changing test conditions visible.
description.zh: 让变化的试验条件可见。

assets.description_en: Compare the consequences of two options.
assets.description_zh: 比较两种选择带来的结果。

description.en: Compare the consequences of two options.
description.zh: 比较两种选择带来的结果。

assets.description_en: Use another pass to improve the result.
assets.description_zh: 通过下一轮改善结果。

description.en: Use another pass to improve the result.
description.zh: 通过下一轮改善结果。

assets.description_en: Try distinct routes from the same starting point.
assets.description_zh: 从相同起点尝试不同路径。

description.en: Try distinct routes from the same starting point.
description.zh: 从相同起点尝试不同路径。

assets.description_en: Hold one small sample still enough to examine.
assets.description_zh: 稳住一个小样本以便观察。

description.en: Hold one small sample still enough to examine.
description.zh: 稳住一个小样本以便观察。

assets.description_en: Make progress through a sequence of usable steps.
assets.description_zh: 通过连续而可行的小步取得进展。

description.en: Make progress through a sequence of usable steps.
description.zh: 通过连续而可行的小步取得进展。

assets.description_en: Turn accumulated intent into forward movement.
assets.description_zh: 把积累的意图变成前进动作。

description.en: Turn accumulated intent into forward movement.
description.zh: 把积累的意图变成前进动作。

assets.description_en: Build a clear route from effort to movement.
assets.description_zh: 建立从投入到行动的清楚路径。

description.en: Build a clear route from effort to movement.
description.zh: 建立从投入到行动的清楚路径。

assets.description_en: Hand useful progress to the next person.
assets.description_zh: 把有用的进展交给下一个人。

description.en: Hand useful progress to the next person.
description.zh: 把有用的进展交给下一个人。

assets.description_en: Open enough structure for the next scale.
assets.description_zh: 为下一阶段打开足够的结构。

description.en: Open enough structure for the next scale.
description.zh: 为下一阶段打开足够的结构。

assets.description_en: Catch existing momentum and give it direction.
assets.description_zh: 接住已有的动量并给它方向。

description.en: Catch existing momentum and give it direction.
description.zh: 接住已有的动量并给它方向。
